item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Momoiro Nadeshiko
  • 発売日: 2022-10-28
  • スコア: 6.35/10 (33 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 元社畜のオレが美少女JKに拾われて甘々癒されエロ同棲生活
  • 英語名: Moto Shachiku no Ore ga Bishoujo JK ni Hirowarete Amaama Iyasare Ero Dousei Seikatsu

あらすじ

“I’ll pamper you as much as you like, okay♪”

Shin-ichi worked for a black company. While visiting a hospital because of his health condition, he saved a schoolgirl who was about to have an accident. He got injured and was hospitalized, resulting in him losing his job.
